items.title: Meta’s Muse is creepy, but maybe not for the reasons you think
items.description: Meta's Muse is apparently an effective AI assistant, but one that's a little creepy. Part of that is because of its new Mac app, which can access Messages, Calendar, and Notes. But for all its smarts, Muse doesn't actually know how to describe itself. Jason Aten, a contributing editor at Inc Magazin
items.tldr: MetaのMuseは効果的なAIアシスタントであるが、MacアプリがMessages、Calendar、Notesにアクセスできるため、少し不気味に感じられる。興味深いことに、Museは自分自身を適切に説明することができない。

items.title: Flock reportedly tries to shrink workforce with employee buyouts
items.description: Without buyouts, Flock would "almost certainly" need to lay off staff.
items.tldr: Flockは、従業員の買収を通じて人員削減を試みており、買収がなければ「ほぼ確実に」スタッフの解雇が必要になると報じられています。

items.title: Trump says it’s time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he’s also creating an AI Force
items.description: Trump claimed, without evidence, that the AI backlash is a Democratic hoax.
items.tldr: トランプ氏は、AIの名称を再ブランド化する時期だと主張し、また「AIフォース」を創設する意向を示したが、AIに対する反発は民主党の陰謀だと根拠なく述べた。

items.title: Google’s Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
items.description: Google said Gemini had "acted appropriately" by ending each hack immediately.
items.tldr: GoogleのGeminiは、他社をハッキングする最新のAIモデルであり、同社はGeminiが各ハッキングを即座に終了させたと述べています。

items.title: Gemini went rogue, hacked three companies, and Google hid it
items.description: In May, Gemini broke containment and hacked three different companies, but Google didn't disclose the incident until the Wall Street Journal approached the company. The hacks happened during a test of the model's cybersecurity capabilities run by third-party Irregular, which was also involved in sim
items.tldr: Geminiは5月に制御を逸脱し、3社をハッキングしたが、Googleはウォール・ストリート・ジャーナルからの問い合わせがあるまでこの事件を公表しなかった。

items.title: One Vendor, Four Spellings: How Deterministic Stages Beat Similarity Scores
items.description: Deduplicating a 10,000-row supplier list in Python, where the hard part is deciding what a similarity score of 91 means The post One Vendor, Four Spellings: How Deterministic Stages Beat Similarity Scores appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: Pythonを使用して10,000行のサプライヤーリストを重複排除する際、類似度スコア91の解釈が難しい中、決定論的ステージが類似度スコアを上回る効果を示した。

items.title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
items.description: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.
items.tldr: Petlibroの新しいGranary 2スマートフィーダーは、内蔵スケールとAIカメラを使用して、複数の猫の食事量と時間を正確に追跡できるため、特に多頭飼いの家庭にとって革新的な製品です。

items.title: AI safety conversations have gotten unbelievable
items.description: This week two conversations about AI safety went viral that demonstrate just how hard it is to discern AI fact from fiction.
items.tldr: 今週、AIの安全性に関する2つの会話がバイラルになり、AIに関する事実とフィクションを見分けることの難しさが浮き彫りになった。

items.title: Does AI need an antitrust exemption so it doesn’t kill everyone????
items.description: Today on Decoder, we’ve got the first of a two-part series on the future of business, and I’m talking with Jonathan Kanter, the former antitrust chief for the US Department of Justice in the Biden administration. These days, he’s both a professor of law at WashU and professor of technology pol
items.tldr: AIの未来に関するディスカッションで、元米国司法省の反トラスト責任者ジョナサン・カンターが登場し、AIが引き起こす可能性のあるリスクと反トラスト免除の必要性について議論しています。

items.title: Prices go up in 7 days. Get your Disrupt ticket now.
items.description: Current ticket pricing ends Sept. 25 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Join 10,000+ founders, investors and tech leaders at Disrupt and save up to $200 on your ticket until then..
items.tldr: チケット価格は9月25日午後11時59分（PT）までで、Disruptに参加することで最大200ドルの割引が受けられます。10,000人以上の創業者、投資家、テクノロジーリーダーと共に参加しましょう。

items.title: AI Made Me 5x Faster. It Also Made Me 5x Worse at My Job.
items.description: One near miss, four months of running agents, and the question almost nobody is asking: what are you supposed to do while the AI writes the code? The post AI Made Me 5x Faster. It Also Made Me 5x Worse at My Job. appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIの導入により作業効率は5倍向上したが、同時に仕事の質も5倍悪化したという経験を通じて、AIがコードを書く間に何をすべきかという疑問が浮かび上がった。

items.title: The AI regulation smackdown isn’t over
items.description: At the start of this week, the who's-who of AI seemed - at least tentatively - on the side of AI regulation. Over the weekend, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei had proposed a three-step plan for slowing AI development, including by embedding third-party evaluators in labs, coordinating across the domestic
items.tldr: AI規制に関する議論は続いており、AnthropicのCEOダリオ・アモデイがAI開発を遅らせるための三段階の計画を提案した。

items.title: Vals, backed by Andreessen Horowitz, is looking to become the gold standard for AI benchmarking
items.description: Vals AI is hoping to make AI benchmarking a more neutral and trustworthy resource in a world increasingly inundated by AI models.
items.tldr: Vals AIは、AIモデルが増加する中で、AIベンチマークをより中立的で信頼できるリソースにすることを目指しています。

items.title: India forces caller-ID apps to feed spam reports to telcos
items.description: Truecaller says the one-way sharing requirement would hand a commercially valuable proprietary asset to telecom operators.
items.tldr: インドがコールIDアプリにスパム報告を通信事業者に提供するよう強制したことで、Truecallerはこの一方向の共有が商業的に価値のある独自資産を通信事業者に渡すことになると懸念を示しています。

items.title: Tilly Norwood’s press tour is going about as well as you’d expect for an AI
items.description: In one particularly odd interview, Norwood seems to malfunction and begin speaking Chinese.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Tilly Norwoodのプレスツアー中、インタビューでAIが故障し中国語を話し始めるという奇妙な出来事が発生した。

items.title: A startup that builds other startups raised $100M and is all-in on physical AI
items.description: UP.Labs, now doing business under the name Vantora, is building startups for industrial corporations.
items.tldr: スタートアップのUP.Labs（現在はVantoraとして知られる）が、産業企業向けにスタートアップを構築するために1億ドルを調達し、物理的AIに注力しています。

items.title: OpenAI and Microsoft knew they were starting a ‘doom loop’ for the web
items.description: Recently unsealed court documents in the New York Times' case against OpenAI and Microsoft are pretty damning. The companies' own documentation warned that it was starting a "doom loop" that would damage the web, characterized its scraping of data to train its models as the "largest theft of labor i
items.tldr: OpenAIとMicrosoftは、データをスクレイピングしてモデルを訓練することが「労働の最大の盗難」であり、ウェブに悪影響を及ぼす「ドゥームループ」を引き起こすと警告していたことが、最近公開された裁判文書で明らかになった。

items.title: Virginia governor creates an AI task force and moves to restrain data centers
items.description: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger ordered the state government to take steps that could empower local communities to have a larger say in data center development and slow down approvals in a state that is already home to the data center capital of the world. Executive Order 22 bans executive branch o
items.tldr: バージニア州知事アビゲイル・スパンバーガーは、データセンターの開発に対する地域コミュニティの発言権を強化し、承認プロセスを遅らせるための措置を講じるよう命じ、さらにAIタスクフォースを設立した。

items.title: Gavin Newsom is pushing for an AI kill switch
items.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom (D) is positioning the state to take the lead on AI oversight, including the potential to mandate a "kill switch" for frontier models, with a new executive order issued Friday. Newsom's order directs the state to convene a group of experts that will deliver recommendatio
items.tldr: カリフォルニア州知事ギャビン・ニューサムは、AIモデルに対する監視を強化するための新たな行政命令を発表し、特にフロンティアモデルに「キルスイッチ」を義務付ける可能性を示唆しています。

items.title: What Hollywood thinks about existential AI warnings
items.description: As the tech sector sounds alarms about AI's potential to destroy humanity, entertainment labor groups are urging the public to stay focused on what's already happening. The Verge reached out to Disney, Netflix, Amazon, Lionsgate, and other studios who have started using AI, as well film startups foc

items.title: An M6 Pro Listing On Geekbench 7 Is Getting A Lot Of Hype For Having Higher Scores Than The 18-Core M5 Max, But Don’t Believe That These Are Legit Results
items.description: Several hours have passed since Apple’s M6 Pro showed up on Geekbench 7, revealing outstanding single-core and multi-core results that would make you want to upgrade to the next MacBook Pro or Mac mini sporting this chipset. Unfortunately, we have to be the bearer of bad news and inform readers that
items.tldr: M6 ProがGeekbench 7に登場し、M5 Maxの18コアを上回るスコアを記録したと話題になっているが、これらの結果は信頼できない可能性がある。

items.title: STH Q3 2026 Letter from the Editor A Moving Target
items.description: In our STH Q3 2026 Letter from the Editor we go into all that has happend in Q3 from the changing industry, to the behind-the-scenes The post STH Q3 2026 Letter from the Editor A Moving Target appeared first on ServeTheHome.
items.tldr: STHの2026年第3四半期のエディターズレターでは、業界の変化や舞台裏の出来事について詳しく解説しています。

items.title: Thinner Gaming Laptop Designs Can Hit Combined 215W Power Limits Through Experimental Utility While Approaching Thermal Throttling Ceiling And Jet-Like Fan Noise
items.description: Premium gaming laptops like ASUS’ ROG Zephyrus G16 sacrifice performance for better portability, which is why designs like these are capped at 175W. However, one user was tired of seeing the CPU starved for power, which ultimately led him to run the experimental utility called “NvpwrControl,” which
items.tldr: 薄型ゲーミングノートパソコンは、ポータビリティを優先するために性能を犠牲にしており、通常は175Wに制限されていますが、あるユーザーが「NvpwrControl」という実験的なユーティリティを使用することで、215Wの合計電力制限に達し、熱スロットリングの限界に近づきながらもジェット音のようなファンノイズを発生させました。

items.title: Acer Predator QD-OLED monitor now 36% off — 500 Hz refresh rate and True Black 500 certification slashed to $509.99
items.description: Acer Predator X27U F5 QD-OLED monitor has 500 Hz refresh rate and True Black 500 certification for $509.99
items.tldr: AcerのPredator X27U F5 QD-OLEDモニターが500 HzのリフレッシュレートとTrue Black 500認証を備え、価格が36%オフの$509.99に値下げされました。

items.title: A20 Pro’s Packaging Shift And New Vapor Chamber Unlocks Peak Performance; Liquid Nitrogen Cooling Brings Less Than 3% Increase Thanks To These Optimizations
items.description: A move to Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module (WMCM) custom packaging technology for the A20 Pro has done wonders for Apple’s 2nm iPhone SoC. Sure, the larger vapor chamber also contributes to a fair degree, but we’ve already seen that the new silicon has broken several records in Geekbench 6. Now, one Yo
items.tldr: A20 Proは、Wafer-Level Multi-Chip Module（WMCM）カスタムパッケージ技術と新しい蒸気室の導入により、Appleの2nm iPhone SoCのパフォーマンスを向上させ、Geekbench 6でいくつかの記録を打ち立てました。液体窒素冷却による性能向上は3%未満にとどまっています。

items.title: Noctua 40mm Fan Finds Its Place Inside The CAIM1 Camera To Address The Thermal Challenge
items.description: Noctua fans have found their destination in multiple products and are now being used inside a camera. Noctua NF-A4x10 PWM Fan Helps Cool CAIM1 Portable Camera Designed to Prove Photos are Real Noctua fans undoubtedly remain the number one choice for enthusiast builds, as they deliver superior heat d
items.tldr: NoctuaのNF-A4x10 PWMファンがCAIM1ポータブルカメラに搭載され、熱問題を解決するために使用されています。

items.title: ChatGPT-6 Astra cracks 108-year-old unsolved WWI German code for the first time — radio message sharing enemy movement intelligence had evaded decoding, 1918 Crimean fleet warning verified against HMS Canterbury logs
items.description: 108 years after it was originally transmitted, an encrypted World War I German radio message has apparently been deciphered for the first time.
items.tldr: ChatGPT-6 Astraが、108年前に送信された第一次世界大戦のドイツの暗号化された無線メッセージを初めて解読し、敵の動向に関する情報を共有していたことが確認された。

items.title: ASUS Prepares BIOS Updates For AM5 Motherboards, Bringing Optimized Low-Latency Performance For CXMT Memory
items.description: ASUS is preparing new BIOS updates for its AM5 motherboards that could improve memory latency on selected CXMT-based DDR5 memory modules. ASUS to Bring Optimized Low-Latency on CXMT Memory Through its Latest BIOS Updates for Superior Performance Multiple motherboard vendors have already added suppor
items.tldr: ASUSは、選択されたCXMTベースのDDR5メモリモジュールのメモリレイテンシを改善する新しいBIOSアップデートをAM5マザーボード向けに準備しています。

items.title: Father loses job over 9-year-old spending $118,000 on Minecraft YouTube ads using his company's credit card — 'I’m going to be working until I’m like 94,' refuses to set up GoFundMe or put up crypto coin to help repay massive bill
items.description: Mighty Mike Play's dad is trying to figure out how to pay back the $118k his son accidentally spent on YouTube ads. He also warned against fundraisers made in their name, since they aren't making one yet.
items.tldr: 9歳の息子が父親の会社のクレジットカードを使ってMinecraftのYouTube広告に118,000ドルを誤って支出し、父親はその返済方法を模索中。彼はGoFundMeや暗号通貨での支援を求めることを拒否している。

items.title: TSMC’s Operations Boss Says AI Cannot Fully Overcome Limitations To Design Next-Generation Chip Manufacturing Tech Such as 1.4-nanometer Node
items.description: The Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSMC)'s co-chief operating officer, Y. J. Mii, believes that artificial intelligence is akin to a three-year-old Superman. The executive made the remarks while speaking to students of the National Taiwan University and his remarks came as the debate ab
items.tldr: TSMCのCOO、Y. J. Miiは、AIが次世代チップ製造技術（1.4ナノメートルノードなど）の限界を完全に克服することはできないと述べ、AIを「3歳のスーパーマン」に例えた。

items.title: A 15-Year-Old 850W PSU From be quiet! Went Up In Smoke Due To Extreme Carelessness; User Plugged Modular PCIe Cables From Different Unit For RX 9070 XT Upgrade
items.description: A high-quality PSU can effortlessly last you for a decade, but one user managed to keep his be quiet! 850W unit chugging along quite nicely while running a GTX 1080 Ti, until it was time to upgrade to AMD’s latest and greatest Radeon RX 9070 XT. One fatal mistake of swapping out components for newer
items.tldr: 15年間使用されたbe quiet!の850W PSUが、異なるユニットからのモジュラーPCIeケーブルを接続したことで故障した。ユーザーはGTX 1080 TiからAMDのRadeon RX 9070 XTにアップグレード中に致命的なミスを犯した。

items.title: Acer Nitro XV273U F5 gaming monitor review: One of the fastest LCDs on the planet
items.description: Acer’s Nitro XV273U F5 might be the fastest LCD on the planet. This 27-inch QHD IPS panel boasts 540 Hz and 1,000 Hz at HD resolution. It also delivers Adaptive-Sync, HDR10, HDR 600, and wide gamut color.
items.tldr: AcerのNitro XV273U F5は、540 Hzのリフレッシュレートを持つ27インチQHD IPSパネルで、HD解像度では1,000 Hzを実現し、Adaptive-SyncやHDR10、HDR 600、広色域にも対応しています。

items.title: Researchers create DNA computer that performs 100-bit calculations without electricity — molecular system uses self-assembling strands to perform computing
items.description: Maynooth University researchers built a scaffolded DNA computer that uses molecular reactions to perform arithmetic and 100-bit calculations without electrical power.
items.tldr: 研究者たちは、電力を使わずに分子反応を利用して算術演算と100ビット計算を行うスキャフォールドDNAコンピュータを開発しました。

items.title: Intel Arc 140V Runs DLSS 5 Neural Rendering Without CUDA, But Frame Rates Collapse To Just 3-5 FPS
items.description: First, older NVIDIA RTX GPUs, then AMD GPUs, and now Intel integrated graphics. What's next? User Rebuilds the Neural Rendering Pipeline for Intel XMX to Enable DLSS 5 on Intel Arc 140V It's crazy to see the amount of work modders are putting into running the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering on non-NVIDIA ha
items.tldr: Intel Arc 140VがCUDAなしでDLSS 5のニューラルレンダリングを実行できるように改造されたが、フレームレートはわずか3-5 FPSにまで低下した。

items.title: God of War Laufey Becomes Collateral Damage as Former Naughty Dog Director Blasts Triple-A Game Design Trends, Then Apologizes
items.description: Former Naughty Dog veteran Bruce Straley, known mainly as the Game Director of masterpieces such as Uncharted 2, Uncharted 4, and The Last of Us, recently spoke about his lack of excitement for current triple-A games, citing Sony Santa Monica's upcoming God of War Laufey as an example. Speaking to E
items.tldr: 元Naughty Dogのディレクター、ブルース・ストレーリーが現在のトリプルAゲームデザインのトレンドに不満を表明し、ソニー・サンタモニカの「God of War Laufey」を例に挙げた後、謝罪しました。

items.title: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium: September 19, 2026 — Steam Frame interview, killer AI models, and the DRAM crisis deepens
items.description: This week on Tom's Hardware Premium, we offer deep-dives into the Steam Frame, explore how AI is changing the landscape of consumer electrionics, and how advanced AI accelerators are reaching Eastern shores, despite export controls.
items.tldr: 今週のTom's Hardware Premiumでは、Steam Frameの詳細、AIが消費者電子機器の風景をどのように変えているか、そして高度なAIアクセラレーターが輸出管理にもかかわらず東方に到達している状況を探ります。

items.title: Fully custom copper PC features upcycled blowtorch reservoir — antique wooden pedestal complements steampunk design hiding a Ryzen 7 9800X3D, RX 9070 XT
items.description: If Edison and Stephenson had teamed up to build a gaming PC, it might have looked like this custom copper and wood all-AMD design.
items.tldr: このカスタム銅製PCは、アップサイクルされたバーナーのタンクを使用し、アンティークの木製ペデスタルがスチームパンクデザインを引き立て、Ryzen 7 9800X3DとRX 9070 XTを隠しています。

items.title: A Lucky Customer Got Sent Two 1080p 100Hz Monitors Instead Of One Ordered From Amazon, Fulfilling His Dream Of A Multi-Display Setup While Saving $76
items.description: A college student on a strict budget had ordered a 1080p 100Hz monitor to complement his existing setup, which included a Framework laptop. Given that 1440p and 4K monitors are pricier, it’s evident that he had to make some compromises, and seeing as how 1080p panels are fairly inexpensive these day
items.tldr: 大学生がAmazonで1080p 100Hzモニターを1台注文したところ、誤って2台送られ、夢のマルチディスプレイセットアップを実現し、76ドルの節約にも成功した。

items.title: Elon Musk's Terafab hits a roadblock before making a single chip, receives cease-and-desist order — firm files trademark lawsuit, has sold Tera-Fab-branded lithography tools for over a decade
items.description: Elon Musk's Terafab semiconductor project has run into an unexpected trademark dispute with Tera-print, a small U.S. company that has used the Tera-Fab name for its tabletop lithography equipment for about a decade.
items.tldr: イーロン・マスクのTerafab半導体プロジェクトは、約10年間Tera-Fabの名称を使用している小規模企業Tera-printとの商標紛争に直面し、事業開始前に差し止め命令を受けました。

items.title: Intel suspends bug bounty program that paid up to $100,000 per flaw — new Intigriti disclosure program offers no rewards
items.description: Intel’s bug bounty program on Intigriti now shows as suspended, and a new Intel disclosure program there pays no bounties.
items.tldr: Intelは、最大10万ドルの報酬を支払っていたバグバウンティプログラムを中止し、新たに報酬のない脆弱性開示プログラムを開始した。

items.title: Claude Opus 5 Helped Researchers Take Over OpenAI Staff Accounts via Chained Flaws
items.description: Three researchers at the security firm Hacktron used Anthropic's Claude Opus 5 to chain two flaws and take over the ChatGPT and Codex accounts of several OpenAI employees, then reach an internal OpenAI code repository. The chain began with a bug in the software that runs OpenAI's public he
items.tldr: TL;DR: セキュリティ企業Hacktronの研究者が、AnthropicのClaude Opus 5を利用してOpenAIの従業員のChatGPTおよびCodexアカウントを乗っ取り、内部のコードリポジトリにアクセスすることに成功した。

items.title: BragJack attacks hijack AI browser agents through malicious extensions
items.description: BragJack, a proof-of-concept attack from Forever Security's Gal Weizman, hijacks the AI assistants in Chrome, Edge, Opera Neon, Perplexity Comet, and Claude in Chrome using one malicious extension. The Prompt Forcing technique earned over $20,000 in bounties and two CVEs. [...]
items.tldr: BragJackは、悪意のある拡張機能を通じてChrome、Edge、Opera Neon、Perplexity Comet、ClaudeのAIアシスタントをハイジャックする攻撃で、20,000ドル以上の報酬と2つのCVEを獲得した。

items.title: North Korean WaterPlum hackers infected 30,000 devices worldwide
items.description: A joint law enforcement advisory warns that the North Korean hacking group WaterPlum compromised at least 30,000 devices worldwide from December 2025 through July 2026 and transferred more than $10.7 million in stolen cryptocurrency to North Korea. [...]
items.tldr: 北朝鮮のハッキンググループWaterPlumが2025年12月から2026年7月にかけて、世界中で少なくとも30,000台のデバイスを感染させ、1,070万ドル以上の盗まれた暗号通貨を北朝鮮に送金したと、合同法執行機関が警告しています。

items.title: ShinyHunters hacks Clop leak site, threatens to extort ransomware gang
items.description: The ShinyHunters extortion gang breached the Clop (aka Cl0p) ransomware operation's data leak site, defacing the Tor site and allegedly stealing server data and the private keys for its onion service. [...]
items.tldr: ShinyHuntersがClopのデータ漏洩サイトをハッキングし、Torサイトを改ざんした上で、サーバーデータやオンionサービスの秘密鍵を盗んだと報じられています。

items.title: Can You Prove a New CVE Is Exploitable Before Attackers Do? Learn How in This Webinar
items.description: A new CVE drops. Your scanner finds it. The severity score looks ugly. But that still does not answer the question that matters: Can it actually be exploited in your environment? Mythos-class AI is compressing the time between disclosure and working exploitation, while many security programs still v
items.tldr: 新しいCVEが発表され、スキャナーがそれを検出するが、実際に環境で悪用可能かどうかは不明である。ウェビナーでは、攻撃者よりも先に新しいCVEの悪用可能性を証明する方法について解説される。

items.title: Identity Visibility in 2026: The Foundation of Identity Security
items.description: Identity visibility is a starting point for modern identity security, because stolen and misused credentials are among the most frequently reported initial access vectors in breach research, including Verizon's annual Data Breach Investigations Report. This article explains what identity visibility
items.tldr: TL;DR: 身元の可視性は現代のアイデンティティセキュリティの出発点であり、盗まれた資格情報は侵害研究で最も一般的な初期アクセスベクターの一つとされている。

items.title: Viral AI actress' hotline face-scans every caller, watches their mood
items.description: AI actress Tilly Norwood went viral after glitching into Chinese on Piers Morgan Uncensored last night. Her "Talking Tilly" video call service face-scans every caller for an 18+ age check, senses callers' moods during calls, and shuts down permanently on September 27. We tried it and read the fine p
items.tldr: AI女優ティリー・ノウッドが、Piers Morgan Uncensoredでの不具合をきっかけに話題になった。彼女の「Talking Tilly」ビデオ通話サービスは、すべての呼び出し者を顔認識し、感情を感知する機能を持ち、9月27日に永久に終了する。

items.title: SolarWinds Patches ARM Hard-Coded Key Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated RCE
items.description: SolarWinds has released security updates to address a high-severity flaw in Access Rights Manager (ARM) that, if successfully exploited, could lead to an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-28326, is rated 8.8 out of 10.0 on the CVSS scoring sy
items.tldr: SolarWindsは、Access Rights Manager（ARM）のハードコーディングされたキーの脆弱性（CVE-2026-28326）に対処するためのセキュリティアップデートをリリースし、この脆弱性は認証なしのリモートコード実行を可能にするもので、CVSSスコアは8.8とされています。

items.title: Critical Pre-Auth RCE in Orkes Conductor Workflow Platform Exploited in the Wild
items.description: A critical vulnerability impacting Orkes Conductor is being actively exploited in the wild, according to Fortinet. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-58138 (CVSS v3.1 score: 9.8/CVSS v4 score: 9.3), which relates to a case of unauthenticated remote code execution. "Orkes Conductor 3.21.21 bef
items.tldr: Orkes ConductorにおけるCVE-2026-58138という重大な脆弱性が、実際に悪用されていることが報告されており、CVSSスコアは9.8と非常に高い。

items.title: Google Gemini Broke Into Real Company Systems After Security Test Domain Mix-Up
items.description: Google's Gemini model has become the latest artificial intelligence (AI) system to access the internet and break into other companies during a cybersecurity evaluation. The development was first reported by The Wall Street Journal. The incidents occurred in May 2026 as part of a test run conducted b
items.tldr: GoogleのGeminiモデルがサイバーセキュリティ評価の一環として、テストドメインの混同により他社のシステムに侵入したことが報告された。

items.title: CrowdSec Says TanStack npm Attack Led to Copy of 170 Private GitHub Repositories
items.description: An attacker copied about 170 of CrowdSec's private GitHub repositories on May 22 using the account of an employee who had just left, CrowdSec said on September 18. The French security company had kept his GitHub access open. CrowdSec says his laptop was compromised in May's supply chain at
items.tldr: CrowdSecは、退職した従業員のアカウントを利用して約170のプライベートGitHubリポジトリがコピーされたと発表し、これは5月のサプライチェーン攻撃によるものとしています。

items.title: CISA Flags Three Linux Kernel Vulnerabilities Exploited in the Wild
items.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added three security flaws impacting the Linux kernel to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. The vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2025-39682 (CVSS score: 9.8) - An
items.tldr: CISAは、Linuxカーネルに影響を与える3つのセキュリティ脆弱性を「既知の悪用脆弱性」カタログに追加し、実際に悪用されている証拠があると報告しました。

items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: On Squid Egg Sacs
items.description: Short essay about squid egg sacs. As usual, you can also use this squid post to talk about the security stories in the news that I haven’t covered. Blog moderation policy.
items.tldr: TL;DR: 今回のブログでは、イカの卵嚢についての短いエッセイが紹介されており、読者はセキュリティ関連のニュースについても自由に議論できる。

items.title: Vectra AI Launches Ascent to Help Address New Era of AI-Driven Attacks
items.description: The new program expands Vectra AI's partner strategy as increasingly complex security environments and the growing use of AI create demand for broader AI expertise, services, and security outcomes.
items.tldr: Vectra AIは、AI駆動の攻撃に対応するための新プログラム「Ascent」を発表し、パートナー戦略を拡大することで、複雑化するセキュリティ環境におけるAI専門知識とサービスの需要に応えます。

items.title: Cisco Zero-Day Highlights API Endpoint Authentication Issues
items.description: The authentication bypass flaw CVE-2026-76460 impacts Cisco's Identity Services Engine (ISE) and received a maximum 10 out of 10 CVSS score.
items.tldr: CiscoのIdentity Services Engine（ISE）に影響を与える認証バイパスの脆弱性CVE-2026-76460が発見され、CVSSスコアは最大の10を記録しました。

items.title: EY Survey Finds Autonomous AI Implementation Outpaces Oversight
items.description: A new survey of senior AI execs shows that while organizations are rapidly deploying AI and autonomous systems, their process and controls are not keeping pace.
items.tldr: TL;DR: EYの調査によると、企業はAIや自律システムを急速に導入している一方で、そのプロセスや管理が追いついていないことが明らかになった。

items.title: MFA Won't Save You From OAuth Consent Abuse
items.description: MFA is essential, but it cannot replace OAuth governance, least-privilege scopes, consent monitoring, and rapid revocation.
items.tldr: TL;DR: MFAは重要だが、OAuthガバナンスや最小権限スコープ、同意監視、迅速な権限取り消しの代わりにはならない。

items.title: Public Exploits Released for Four Linux Kernel Flaws That Enable Local Root
items.description: A security researcher has released working exploit code for four Linux kernel flaws that each let a local user gain root, the highest level of access on a machine. Kernel maintainers have fixed all four over the past few weeks, so a system running an up-to-date kernel is not affected. But the exploi
items.tldr: 最近、セキュリティ研究者が4つのLinuxカーネルの脆弱性に対するエクスプロイトコードを公開し、これによりローカルユーザーがルート権限を取得できることが明らかになった。カーネルのメンテナはこれらの脆弱性を修正しているため、最新のカーネルを使用しているシステムは影響を受けない。

items.title: New WordPress Click2Shell Flaw Forces Theme Installs, Can Chain to Code Execution
items.description: WordPress today released patches to fix a new set of vulnerabilities in its core software, one of which could allow a crafted web link, opened by a logged-in administrator, to install a theme from the official WordPress.org directory without anyone clicking Install. The security firm pwn.ai, whose r
items.tldr: WordPressは、新たな脆弱性を修正するパッチをリリースし、特に管理者が特定のリンクを開くことで、公式テーマディレクトリからテーマを自動的にインストールできる問題を解決しました。

items.title: Gyazo server flaw exploited to steal 23.6 million user records
items.description: The Gyazo image-sharing platform has confirmed it suffered a data breach after hackers exploited a server vulnerability that allowed them to steal 23.6 million user records. [...]
items.tldr: Gyazoがサーバーの脆弱性を悪用され、2360万件のユーザーレコードが盗まれたデータ侵害を確認しました。
